prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic two-set lifestyle collection featuring one original adult woman across an ethereal Mediterranean ruins set and a high-intensity athlete realism set.
prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with a consistent non-celebrity identity across both sets. Set 1 uses graceful contemplative sitting and standing poses in a Grecian sleeveless flowing gown with dusty rose, mauve, emerald, royal blue or yellow color variants and an ornate gold snake armband on the upper arm. Set 2 uses a textured high ponytail, natural workout flush and realistic sweat glow while leaning against gym mirrors. Do not reproduce Ana de Armas or any other public figure.
prompt.composition_elements: Set 1: ancient marble columns stand in shallow crystal-clear water with high-fidelity reflections; style the adult woman in the Grecian flowing gown and gold snake armband. Set 2: industrial modern gym with warm overhead lights and accurate mirror reflections; show the adult woman in either a monochromatic pink sports crop top with drawstring sweatpants or a charcoal-gray racerback with royal-blue side-striped joggers. Keep the two settings visually distinct but identity and realism consistent.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Use cinematic reflected light and clear water highlights for the Mediterranean ruins. Use warm overhead gym lighting with natural sweat sheen and workout flush for the athlete set. Maintain polished 8K editorial realism and clear material, water, marble, mirror and fabric reflections.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 8K-style collection, square 1080x1080 social-media layouts, consistent adult identity, accurate reflections, natural anatomy, realistic gown, athletic fabric, water, marble, gym mirror and skin texture, no text, logos or watermark.
